name: regions
description: Rank-2/CPS scope, ST-shaped indexed effects, existential escape, and checked runtime ownership.

cases.reason: A scoped callback can inspect and finish once.
Rank-2 scope does not prevent aliasing or repeated consumption.
A deferred Effect hides the scope and escapes; it can be replayed.
An existential package hides the scope and escapes; Effect operations remain usable.
The callback's fresh scope cannot escape directly as the caller's scope.
Ordinary scoped use through an abstract region-indexed effect is accepted.
Region confinement does not prevent repeated consumption within the region.
An existential can hide and return a handle, but the indexed operations remain confined.
A directly returned handle retains the fresh scope.
A deferred Region action retains its scope unlike plain Effect.
A fixed existential scope cannot satisfy the rank-2 Region runner.
The installed ST implementation allows aliased references and repeated mutation within a region.
The installed ST runner rejects direct reference escape.
